what_it_is.prose: Thales S.A. (Euronext Paris: HO) is a French listed defence OEM headquartered in Courbevoie. Thales has a long-standing India footprint anchored by the BEL-Thales Systems Limited (BTSL) joint venture — incorporated on 28 August 2014 with BEL holding 74% and Thales 26%, registered in Bengaluru. BTSL is jointly developing a Multi-Target Tracking Radar with Thales Netherlands for Indian weapon systems projects, and announced co-development of the PHAROS fire control radar (for gun and missile systems) in March 2016. The Thales Ground Master 200 (GM200) medium-range 4D AESA radar, with a 250 km range and combat-proven credentials, is a potential fire control radar offering for the Akash-NG and QRSAM programmes. Internationally, Romania ordered 12 GM200 MM/A radars in July 2026, and the Dutch MoD ordered 7 GM200 MM/C radars in April 2024. Thales also has a partnership with HAL on the RDY-3 radar for the Mirage 2000I/H upgrade programme (per AIN Online August 2012), and contributes avionics to the Airbus C-295 India programme.

faq.question: What is the BEL-Thales joint venture?
faq.answer: BEL-Thales Systems Limited (BTSL) is a joint venture incorporated on 28 August 2014 between Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL, 74%) and Thales S.A. (26%), headquartered in Bengaluru. BTSL is jointly developing a Multi-Target Tracking Radar with Thales Netherlands for Indian weapon systems projects, and announced co-development of the PHAROS fire control radar (for gun and missile systems) in March 2016. The JV formation was first reported by AIN Online in August 2012.

faq.question: Does Thales offer the Ground Master 200 radar to India?
faq.answer: Yes. The Thales Ground Master 200 (GM200) is a medium-range 4D AESA radar with 250 km range and combat-proven credentials, offered as a potential fire control radar for the Akash-NG and QRSAM programmes. Internationally, Romania ordered 12 GM200 MM/A radars in July 2026 and the Dutch MoD ordered 7 GM200 MM/C radars in April 2024. However, no confirmed India contract for the GM200 has been publicly announced as of August 2026.

faq.question: What is Thales's role in the C-295 India programme?
faq.answer: Thales contributes avionics to the Airbus C-295 India programme (Atlas slug def-012). The C-295 programme is led by Airbus Defence and Space (Spain) with Tata Advanced Systems Limited (TASL) as the Indian final assembly partner at the Vadodara FAL. Thales is one of several avionics subsystem suppliers in the Airbus C-295 supply chain. The Thales contribution is not separately disclosed in INR value.
